announcements.headline: Result of AGM
announcements.insight: This announcement confirms the outcome of an Annual General Meeting, which is a routine governance event for shareholders.

announcements.headline: Director/PDMR Shareholding
announcements.insight: This announcement indicates that a director or person discharging managerial responsibilities has dealt in the company's shares, which is a routine disclosure of insider trading activity. It provides limited insight into future performance but confirms compliance with transparency regulations regarding insider holdings.

announcements.headline: Annual Financial Report
announcements.insight: This announcement signifies the release of scheduled annual financial results, which provides shareholders with a comprehensive review of the company's performance and financial position over the past year.
